python -m pytest tests/test_writer_refactor.py::TestZeroDuplicatePKs -v

Covers a specific bug fix documented in the CHANGELOG (0.8.1: `annotation_result_status` was claimed to be end-to-end in 0.8.0 but was not). The tests verify:
- Each of the three `AnnotationResult` variants (`AnnotationOk`, `AnnotationNoCategoriesFound`, `AnnotationError`) serializes the correct `annotation_result_status` value into the v2 JSON output.
- `compare_annotations` excludes errored trials from `shared_trials` and counts them in `excluded_errored_trials`.
- `blend()` skips LLM-errored trials.
- `generate_report` surfaces an `## Annotation Quality` section when `annotation_summary` is present, and omits it for v1 documents.
- `FakeLLMBackend.set_next_result` queues results in FIFO order and rejects non-`AnnotationResult` arguments with `TypeError`.
- `annotate_batch_claude_code` and `annotate_batch_api` propagate `AnnotationError` with specific reason strings on subprocess failure.

A comment in the file (`# the CRITICAL fix from the plan-review`) marks the batch error propagation section as the fix identified in a prior review.

### 10. Trial-ID Property Tests (Specific-Change Evidence)

**File:** [`tests/test_trial_id.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-agent-diagnostics@e973e4ec1d4a325b5d739562ce87586127c973ed/-/blob/tests/test_trial_id.py)

Seven named properties (P1–P7) are tested:
- P1: same content, different path → same `trial_id`
- P2: rescoring (different reward) → same `trial_id`
- P3: different `started_at` → different `trial_id`
- P4: different `task_id` or `model` → different `trial_id`
- P5: 100 identical calls → 1 unique result (determinism)
- P6: `trial_id` is 32 hex chars; `trial_id_full` is 64 hex chars
- P7: `trial_id == trial_id_full[:32]`

One test (`test_formula_matches_spec`) hard-codes the expected SHA-256 formula: `sha256(task_id||config_name||started_at||model)` and verifies the implementation matches. A real-corpus collision test is skipped unless `data/signals.jsonl` is present.

**File:** [`tests/test_backend_model_parity.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-agent-diagnostics@e973e4ec1d4a325b5d739562ce87586127c973ed/-/blob/tests/test_backend_model_parity.py)

Asserts `_API_MODEL_MAP.keys() == _MODEL_ALIASES.keys()` bidirectionally, preventing a silent mis-alignment between the two dicts when a new model is added to one but not the other.

---

### 12. Taxonomy Contract Tests (Repository-Wide)

**File:** [`tests/contracts/taxonomy_v3_contract.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-agent-diagnostics@e973e4ec1d4a325b5d739562ce87586127c973ed/-/blob/tests/contracts/taxonomy_v3_contract.py)

Formal contract assertions: `REDACTED_SIGNAL_FIELDS` must be a `frozenset` of flat (non-dotted) strings containing at minimum `{reward, passed, exception_info}`; `valid_category_names()` return annotation must be `Set[str]`; golden fixture directories must exist with `steps`-keyed `trajectory.json`.

**File:** [`tests/test_taxonomy_schema.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-agent-diagnostics@e973e4ec1d4a325b5d739562ce87586127c973ed/-/blob/tests/test_taxonomy_schema.py)

Asserts all 23 v2 categories survive in v3, every category has `severity` (one of `blocker/major/minor`), `derived_from_signal` (bool), and `signal_dependencies` (list of strings), and no duplicate category names exist. The `wrong_tool_choice` category is specifically asserted to be in the `ToolUse` dimension (a noted structural move from v2's `Retrieval` dimension).

---

### 13. Determinism and Golden Corpus Tests (Repository-Wide)

**File:** [`tests/integration/test_determinism.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-agent-diagnostics@e973e4ec1d4a325b5d739562ce87586127c973ed/-/blob/tests/integration/test_determinism.py)

Parameterized over 14 named fixture categories. Two independent `FakeLLMBackend` instances given the same prompt must return byte-identical JSON. A full-sweep test runs all 14 categories through two backends and asserts the artifact sets are equal.

**File:** [`tests/integration/test_golden_corpus.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-agent-diagnostics@e973e4ec1d4a325b5d739562ce87586127c973ed/-/blob/tests/integration/test_golden_corpus.py)

Structural tests only — heuristic recall is computed and printed but **not asserted** (comment: "Calibration thresholds are the job of the downstream calibration bead"). Runtime is bounded at 30 seconds. The corpus `MANIFEST.json` must carry a `cohen_kappa >= 0.6` field, at least 3 agents, 5 benchmarks, and a passed/failed split where neither side exceeds 80% of trials.

---

### 14. Smoke Test (Repository-Wide)

**File:** [`smoke_test.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-agent-diagnostics@e973e4ec1d4a325b5d739562ce87586127c973ed/-/blob/smoke_test.py)

A standalone script (not part of the pytest suite) that exercises the public API: `load_taxonomy()` (expected to return 23 categories), `annotate_trial()` on a minimal signals dict, and `DEFAULT_REGISTRY.all_tools`. It is referenced in `CHANGELOG.md` as the basis for the 0.8.1 patch release ("clean-room smoke of 0.8.0 from PyPI").

---

### 15. CHANGELOG as Change-Tracking Evidence

**File:** [`CHANGELOG.md`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-agent-diagnostics@e973e4ec1d4a325b5d739562ce87586127c973ed/-/blob/CHANGELOG.md)

Three entries are present at this revision:

- **`[Unreleased]`**: `--output-dir` / `--output` deprecation alias for `observatory report`; `--output` emits `DeprecationWarning` and is flagged for removal in 1.0 (`agent-diagnostics-xw7`).
- **`[0.8.1] 2026-04-19`**: Three bug fixes: `.jsonl` input acceptance in `observatory report --annotations`; `annotation_result_status` propagation gap (heuristic path); `observatory calibrate` silent empty-output on join-key mismatch. One internal: `test_version_string` staled after a version bump, followed up by `importlib.metadata` refactor (`agent-diagnostics-9py`).
- **`[0.8.0] 2026-04-19`**: Substantive additions — calibration observability, `observatory calibrate` CLI, golden corpus of 45 trials, content-hash extract cache, pipeline DAG runner, comparative report sections, `trajectory_length`/`total_turns` propagation, `annotation_result_status` end-to-end (claimed but partially incomplete until 0.8.1), `src/` refactor from `print()` to structured logging, `llm_annotator.py` split to 8-module package, `report.py` split to 7-module package.

Bead identifiers (`agent-diagnostics-xw7`, `agent-diagnostics-9py`, `agent-diagnostics-n0n`) appear in the CHANGELOG and in test comments as cross-references to planning artifacts under `.claude/prd-build-artifacts/`.

If a contributor adds a column to `TrialSignals` or `ROW_FIELDS` without re-running the generator, the test fails with a pointer to `python scripts/gen_schema_docs.py`.

The `autogenerated` banner (`<!-- AUTOGENERATED`) is also asserted to be present at the start of every generated file.

**Deterministic verification query:**

```bash
python scripts/gen_schema_docs.py && git diff --exit-code docs/schemas/
# Should produce no diff at this revision
```

### 7. Writer-Refactor Test (Specific-Change Evidence)

**File:** [`tests/test_writer_refactor.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-agent-diagnostics@e973e4ec1d4a325b5d739562ce87586127c973ed/-/blob/tests/test_writer_refactor.py)

Named explicitly as a refactor test. It verifies that all four annotation writers (`cmd_annotate`, `cmd_llm_annotate`, `cmd_predict`, `cmd_ensemble`) route through `AnnotationStore.upsert_annotations()` using the narrow-tall schema. The integration test `TestZeroDuplicatePKs` runs all four writers sequentially on 20 synthetic trials and asserts exactly 80 rows with zero duplicate primary keys. It also asserts `--annotations-out` is registered on all four CLI subcommands (by parsing `--help` output via subprocess).

**Deterministic verification query:**

```bash
python -m pytest tests/test_writer_refactor.py::TestZeroDuplicatePKs -v
# Expected: 1 test passes, 80 rows produced, 0 duplicate PKs
```

### 8. Annotation Status Propagation Test (Specific-Change Evidence)

**File:** [`tests/test_annotation_status_propagation.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-agent-diagnostics@e973e4ec1d4a325b5d739562ce87586127c973ed/-/blob/tests/test_annotation_status_propagation.py)

Covers a specific bug fix documented in the CHANGELOG (0.8.1: `annotation_result_status` was claimed to be end-to-end in 0.8.0 but was not). The tests verify:
- Each of the three `AnnotationResult` variants (`AnnotationOk`, `AnnotationNoCategoriesFound`, `AnnotationError`) serializes the correct `annotation_result_status` value into the v2 JSON output.
- `compare_annotations` excludes errored trials from `shared_trials` and counts them in `excluded_errored_trials`.
- `blend()` skips LLM-errored trials.
- `generate_report` surfaces an `## Annotation Quality` section when `annotation_summary` is present, and omits it for v1 documents.
- `FakeLLMBackend.set_next_result` queues results in FIFO order and rejects non-`AnnotationResult` arguments with `TypeError`.
- `annotate_batch_claude_code` and `annotate_batch_api` propagate `AnnotationError` with specific reason strings on subprocess failure.

A comment in the file (`# the CRITICAL fix from the plan-review`) marks the batch error propagation section as the fix identified in a prior review.

### 9. Security / Adversarial Tests (Repository-Wide)

**File:** [`tests/test_prompt_injection.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-agent-diagnostics@e973e4ec1d4a325b5d739562ce87586127c973ed/-/blob/tests/test_prompt_injection.py)

Verifies that `build_prompt` wraps trajectory content in nonce-delimited `<untrusted_trajectory boundary="UUID">` tags, the ignore directive appears before the tag in the rendered prompt, and a fake-boundary delimiter-breakout attack is contained inside the quarantine zone.

**File:** [`tests/test_signal_leakage.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-agent-diagnostics@e973e4ec1d4a325b5d739562ce87586127c973ed/-/blob/tests/test_signal_leakage.py)

Verifies that `judge_safe_signals` removes `reward`, `passed`, `exception_info`, and `exception_crashed` and does not mutate the original dict.

### 10. Trial-ID Property Tests (Specific-Change Evidence)

**File:** [`tests/test_trial_id.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-agent-diagnostics@e973e4ec1d4a325b5d739562ce87586127c973ed/-/blob/tests/test_trial_id.py)

Seven named properties (P1–P7) are tested:
- P1: same content, different path → same `trial_id`
- P2: rescoring (different reward) → same `trial_id`
- P3: different `started_at` → different `trial_id`
- P4: different `task_id` or `model` → different `trial_id`
- P5: 100 identical calls → 1 unique result (determinism)
- P6: `trial_id` is 32 hex chars; `trial_id_full` is 64 hex chars
- P7: `trial_id == trial_id_full[:32]`

One test (`test_formula_matches_spec`) hard-codes the expected SHA-256 formula: `sha256(task_id||config_name||started_at||model)` and verifies the implementation matches. A real-corpus collision test is skipped unless `data/signals.jsonl` is present.

### 12. Taxonomy Contract Tests (Repository-Wide)

**File:** [`tests/contracts/taxonomy_v3_contract.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-agent-diagnostics@e973e4ec1d4a325b5d739562ce87586127c973ed/-/blob/tests/contracts/taxonomy_v3_contract.py)

Formal contract assertions: `REDACTED_SIGNAL_FIELDS` must be a `frozenset` of flat (non-dotted) strings containing at minimum `{reward, passed, exception_info}`; `valid_category_names()` return annotation must be `Set[str]`; golden fixture directories must exist with `steps`-keyed `trajectory.json`.

**File:** [`tests/test_taxonomy_schema.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-agent-diagnostics@e973e4ec1d4a325b5d739562ce87586127c973ed/-/blob/tests/test_taxonomy_schema.py)

Asserts all 23 v2 categories survive in v3, every category has `severity` (one of `blocker/major/minor`), `derived_from_signal` (bool), and `signal_dependencies` (list of strings), and no duplicate category names exist. The `wrong_tool_choice` category is specifically asserted to be in the `ToolUse` dimension (a noted structural move from v2's `Retrieval` dimension).

### 13. Determinism and Golden Corpus Tests (Repository-Wide)

**File:** [`tests/integration/test_determinism.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-agent-diagnostics@e973e4ec1d4a325b5d739562ce87586127c973ed/-/blob/tests/integration/test_determinism.py)

Parameterized over 14 named fixture categories. Two independent `FakeLLMBackend` instances given the same prompt must return byte-identical JSON. A full-sweep test runs all 14 categories through two backends and asserts the artifact sets are equal.

**File:** [`tests/integration/test_golden_corpus.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-agent-diagnostics@e973e4ec1d4a325b5d739562ce87586127c973ed/-/blob/tests/integration/test_golden_corpus.py)

Structural tests only — heuristic recall is computed and printed but **not asserted** (comment: "Calibration thresholds are the job of the downstream calibration bead"). Runtime is bounded at 30 seconds. The corpus `MANIFEST.json` must carry a `cohen_kappa >= 0.6` field, at least 3 agents, 5 benchmarks, and a passed/failed split where neither side exceeds 80% of trials.
